name: glitchsecure-website
author: GlitchSecure Inc
description: Company website built using Jekyll, TailwindCSS, and Alpine.js

scripts.start: npm run esbuild && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --drafts --future --host localhost --port 4061 --livereload_port 35729
scripts.build: npm run esbuild && JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.publish:
npm run build && echo '
Everything looks good! Pushing to main...
' && git push origin main
